name: Random Equivalence Queries Complexity of Addressing
proof: Restrict here to $n=2^r$ with all r-bit words present, so $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor=\log_2n=r$. Random equivalence-query complexity lies between VC dimension and Littlestone dimension. The established addressing-class values of both bounds are $\lfloor\log n\rfloor$, hence the random equivalence-query value is the same.
details: Scope: complete-code subfamily $n=2^r$, $r\ge1$. The displayed formula is not asserted for arbitrary injective encodings at other n.
